SET UP WITH YOUR OWN MATERIALS AND RATES
Wetcast + Semi-dry + GRC

Spend less time building the first quote.

Forward the enquiry

StoneFlow can read supported emails, PDFs, spreadsheets and images, set up a project and draft a component schedule for review. Your estimator checks dimensions, quantities and anything flagged.

Build and price the schedule

Use your product library, material rates and mould allowances. Bring in Excel or CSV, or combine reusable house types, plots, floors and elevations into one priced quotation.

Issue and follow up

Send branded quotations and track revisions and follow-ups. Customers can accept online with a purchase order. The accepted revision stays linked to the order.

From accepted quote
to confirmed delivery.

Track what’s been released, made, despatched, delivered and invoiced on the same job.

Sales orders

Convert a won quotation to a sales order. Record the customer PO, send an acknowledgement and release work by plot, section or quantity.

Production queue

Plan against material capacity, mould availability and curing time. Print works orders and record quantities made and ready for despatch.

Delivery notes

Build delivery runs and print notes for each load. Capture signatures and photos, and track shortages or replacements.

Invoices

Draft invoices from confirmed deliveries. Record part-payments and credits, review aged debt and export accounting import files.
